sections.kicker: Prepared for Broadway and Opera by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Broadway and Opera owns a good line. The posts sometimes sound like another school.
sections.keep: The serif type and the teal and purple tiles. They look like a studio with taste.

pins.what: A short line in the bio holds the whole philosophy.
pins.why: It is the reason to choose this teacher over a school with a better location.
pins.how: Make it the first thing every post and page says.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Students pick by price and distance, because nothing else is clear.

pins.what: One caption shouts in capital letters.
pins.why: It sounds like a different account from the quiet serif tile it sits under.
pins.how: Write the captions in the voice of the tiles.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: The warm teacher voice breaks the moment someone reads the caption.

pins.quote: Vocal Studio from Boston to BKK
pins.what: The bio describes where, but not who it is for.
pins.why: Boston to BKK is a story that only people who know the abbreviation can read.
pins.how: Say who the studio is for and where, in plain words.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: New visitors cannot tell if this is a studio for children, adults or both.
